Noman Salarzai had his success with this shot in this innings, but not this time. This was deliberately bowled full on middle. Salarzai tries to get under the ball for the slog sweep. He fails to get any elevation and toe ends the slog to long-on. Yashbardhan takes a straightforward catch well in front of boundary.
